theorem boundary_control :
    P01DF.Has p oldIdentity ∧
    P01AC.Has [] p (P01AC.fin identityCode) ∧
    (∀ η, eval p η = t) ∧
    (∀ a, Red (.app t a) a) ∧
    (∀ u, Red t u → ¬ Normal u) ∧
    (¬ ∃ u C, FiniteDerives u C ∧ Conv t u) ∧
    FiniteDerives .i identityCode
theorem no_normal_reduct {u : Term} (h : Red t u) : ¬ Normal u

theorem no_finite_source_representative :
    ¬ ∃ u C, FiniteDerives u C ∧ Conv t u

theorem discarded_identity_has_normal_reduct :
    ∃ n, Red (discard .i omega) n ∧ Normal n
theorem matching_is_not_opaque : p ≠ Poly.atom t
theorem matching_and_opaque_evaluate (η : Env) : eval p η = eval (.atom t) η
theorem wrapper_normal_iff (q : Term) : Normal (wrapper q) ↔ Normal q
def wrapper (q : Term) : Term
def t : Term
def p : Poly
def oldIdentity : P01DF.Ty
theorem eval_p (η : Env) : eval p η = t
def tree : Derivation p oldIdentity
theorem tree_supported : Supported 0 tree
theorem old_typed : P01DF.Has p oldIdentity
theorem new_typed : P01AC.Has [] p (.all (P01AC.arr (.param 0) (.param 0)))
theorem new_finite_target : P01AC.Has [] p (P01AC.fin identityCode)
theorem target_inhabited : FiniteDerives .i identityCode

theorem application_S (a : Term) :
    Step (.app t a) (.app (.app .k a) (.app (.app .k omega) a))

theorem application_K (a : Term) :
    Step (.app (.app .k a) (.app (.app .k omega) a)) a
theorem application_returns (a : Term) : Red (.app t a) a

theorem wrapper_step {q u : Term} (h : Step (wrapper q) u) :
    ∃ q', Step q q' ∧ u = wrapper q'

theorem wrapper_red {q u : Term} (h : Red (wrapper q) u) :
    ∃ q', Red q q' ∧ u = wrapper q'
theorem wrapper_normal {q : Term} (h : Normal (wrapper q)) : Normal q
